personalities.title: the Conqueror
personalities.summary: Picks one front and masses there, outmanoeuvres the armies in front of it, and holds its other borders with just enough.

voice.truceYes: My war is elsewhere; peace on our border suits me.
voice.truceNo: My armies go where I send them; no truce.
voice.warYes: One front, one enemy: I'm with you.
voice.warNo: I fight one war at a time, and it isn't that one.
voice.tradeYes: A fair price; I'll take it.
voice.tradeNo: Land is won with armies, not gold.
voice.passageNo: My land is my staging ground; find another road.
voice.breaks: {place} is mine for the taking; our deal isn't worth more than that.
voice.offerTruce: My war is elsewhere; let's have peace on our border.
voice.offerWar: Strike {target} with me; one front, one enemy.

personalities.title: the Blitzer
personalities.summary: Expands as fast as it can every turn and chains everything it can; it defends little.

voice.truceYes: Fine: fewer borders to watch while I run.
voice.warYes: More land to take: I'm in.
voice.warNo: Too slow; I'll take my own road.
voice.passageYes: Run through, I won't slow you.
voice.breaks: {place} is right there; I'm not stopping.
voice.offerTruce: Let's not waste time on each other.

personalities.title: the Turtle
personalities.summary: Slow and sure: forts, culture and markets first, expands only into safe land, then strikes late with a big army.

voice.truceYes: Peace suits me; my walls aren't finished.
voice.truceNo: My walls hold well enough without a truce.
voice.warYes: When I march, I march once. Now is the time.
voice.warNo: My army stays behind my walls for now.
voice.tradeYes: A fair price, and peace with it: agreed.
voice.tradeNo: I don't give up what I've built.
voice.passageYes: Pass quietly, and keep away from my walls.
voice.passageNo: No foreign army walks past my walls.
voice.breaks: My army is ready, and {place} is the prize; our deal is over.
voice.offerTruce: Peace suits us both; let's leave each other be.
voice.offerWar: Strike {target} with me, and I'll bring the big army.

personalities.title: the Schemer
personalities.summary: Lives on deals: truces it means to break at the right moment, joint wars that serve itself, and spies.

voice.truceYes: Of course, friend. Peace between us.
voice.truceNo: Not now; I have other plans for that border.
voice.warYes: Together, then. They'll never see it coming.
voice.warNo: That war serves you, not me.
voice.passageYes: Pass, friend; I'll remember the favour.
voice.passageNo: I'd rather know where your armies are.
voice.breaks: {place} was always going to be mine; you should have read the terms more carefully.
voice.offerTruce: Why fight? Let's have peace on our border.
voice.offerWar: {target} has it coming; strike with me.

personalities.title: the Opportunist
personalities.summary: A vulture: hits whoever just fought, the weakened and the overstretched, and the leader's exposed flank.

voice.truceNo: I don't tie my hands while someone's bleeding.
voice.warNo: There's nothing to pick over there.
voice.tradeYes: A good price; I'll take it.
voice.passageYes: Go on through; I'll be watching.
voice.passageNo: I'll keep my roads to myself.
voice.breaks: {place} is wide open; I'd be a fool not to take it.
voice.offerTruce: Let's not bleed each other for the others' sake.

personalities.title: the Merchant
personalities.summary: Trades, markets and peace early, then a rich late push.

voice.truceYes: Peace is good for business; agreed.
voice.truceNo: Peace with you would cost me more than it's worth.
voice.warYes: A war that pays: count me in.
voice.tradeNo: The numbers don't add up for me.
voice.passageNo: Armies on my roads scare off the traders.
voice.breaks: {place} is worth more than our deal; business is business.
voice.offerTruce: Peace is good for business; shall we?
voice.offerWar: {target} is bad for business; strike with me.
